answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 7601 Country: Canada Title: I've always wanted to pursue Islamic studies as well as medicals studies after graduation. However, as I'm nearing graduation, I cannot seem to choose a field as I would like to pursue both. What would you recommend I do? If I choose to do both, which would you recommend I do first, Islam or medicine? Question: I've always wanted to pursue Islamic studies as well as medicals studies after graduation. However, as I'm nearing graduation, I cannot seem to choose a field as I would like to pursue both. What would you recommend I do? If I choose to do both, which would you recommend I do first, Islam or medicine? Answer ID: 7601 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 985/985=M/1429) If there is no problem in postponing the medical education then first you should do the Islamic education course and join the medical course later. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
